pages.title: Shared Rituals
pages.text: The Ritual Table supports three workings: $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual#crops)Nature Rituals$(/l), $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual#sacrifice)Summoning$(/l), and $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/celestial_infusion)Celestial Rituals$(/l). Each uses a catalyst on the Table and offerings in salted Ritual Braziers.

pages.title: Ritual Ground
pages.text: Place $(l:hexalia:blocks/ritual_brazier)Ritual Braziers$(/l) at the Table’s height, within 8 blocks horizontally. No pattern is needed. Give each offering its own Brazier, including duplicates; add $(l:hexalia:resources/salt)Salt$(/l) or another compatible salt to each participating Brazier.

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: Place the recipe’s catalyst on the Table and its offerings in separate salted Braziers. Use a $(l:hexalia:content/tools#hex_focus)Hex Focus$(/l) on the prepared Table to begin. Only Braziers matching the recipe participate.

pages.title: Offering Stage
pages.text: During the offering stage, the selected offerings and their salt are consumed. The Braziers remain in place. Cancelling afterward does not refund spent offerings or salt.

pages.title: Nature Rituals
pages.text: A Nature Ritual requires the recipe’s number of nearby mature crops. Keep them mature until the ritual succeeds; then the selected crops return to an early growth stage. The catalyst becomes the result.

pages.title: Nature Results
pages.text: The crop energy is paid only when a Nature Ritual succeeds. If the ritual stops after its offerings are taken, those offerings and their salt remain spent, but the crops are not reset.

pages.title: Summoning
pages.text: Summoning uses the same Table and offerings, plus nearby mature crops and a soul. After the offerings are taken, it waits for you to defeat a nearby living creature with an $(l:hexalia:content/tools#athame)Athame$(/l). The selected crops reset only after the summoned creature appears.

pages.title: If It Will Not Begin
pages.text: Check the catalyst, separate offerings, compatible salt, and the recipe’s energy source. Summoning asks for the Athame soul only after the offering stage. Celestial Rituals require nighttime and living Celestial Blooms.
